question: Select the correctly spelled sentence.

options.text: I will definitely attend the conference.
I will definlty attend the conference.
I will definetely attend the conference.
I will definately attend the conference.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. 'I will definitely attend the conference.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"definitely"** means without doubt; certainly. (निश्चित रूप से)

 
 
• **Example: **She will definitely be at the party tonight.
 
 
 
• **"Definitely" **is the correct spelling used to express certainty. (निश्चित रूप से)
 
 
• **Example: **I will definitely finish my work by the end of the day.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. 'I will definitely attend the conference.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Definlty **(गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling of 'definitely'.

 
 
• **Example:** The word 'definlty' is a common misspelling of 'definitely'.
 
 
 
• **Definetely **(गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling of 'definitely'.
 
 
• **Example: **'Definetely' is often misspelled by those who are unsure of the correct spelling.
 
 
 
• **Definately** (गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling of 'definitely'.
 
 
• **Example:** Many people mistakenly write 'definately' instead of 'definitely'.
